correctness.rationale: Complete proof: integer Möbius coefficients factor over selected-coordinate runs; the exact signed-run series (1-z^k)/(1-z^{k+1}) gives coefficients 0 or ±1; the modular gap argument proves maximal monomial degree D=n except in residues 1..k-1 when D=n-r; the explicit top-degree frequency gives a Walsh value exactly 2^(n-D) and all other values are divisible by it; Walsh diagonalization proves the exact pseudoinverse norm. Independently constructed direct Fourier and Möbius checkers passed 90 full spectra, 72 coefficient arrays and 6138 direct character comparisons. The finite tests are corroborating, not proofs of arbitrary k,n.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The uniform-probability reliability polynomial is symmetric in coordinates and does not determine arbitrary-coordinate Fourier coefficients without additional multivariate analysis. A generic ANF-to-Walsh algorithm requires the specific integer monomial coefficients and their top-degree classification as input. Neither inspected work presents the all-k sharp dyadic stability law. Standard transform identities are not claimed new.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Counting and Gray ordering do not imply a uniform sharp minimum over exponentially many signed coordinate characters. NRZI charge statistics are not the arbitrary-coordinate Walsh spectrum. Common-probability reliability polynomials yield weight sums, but not separately each Boolean-lattice Möbius coefficient of the forbidden-run indicator; the latter is the new run-factor theorem. The earlier k=3 fixed-pattern result follows as a strict parameter special case and is not included as a separate finding.

originality.rationale: The arbitrary forbidden-run cap all-coordinate Walsh minimum and complete integral monomial-support classification do not follow by parameter specialization from the inspected fixed-run cases. Full text of the directly relevant generalized Fibonacci string enumeration/Gray-code study and run-length-limited charge-enumeration study was compared with the proof. The independent reliability-polynomial and generic ANF-to-Walsh frameworks provide methods, not the evaluated all-parameter spectral gap. This is a bounded scientific priority judgment; unpublished, unindexed or inaccessible results remain possible.
residual_risks: Historical reliability and Boolean-circuit literature may encode the same run-factor identity under other terminology.
Complete original text of Gupta–Sarkar was not inspected; the general algorithm could supply related transformations.
Canonical full-page reading of Cowell was access-restricted though a scholarly full-text rendering was material-read.
A prior fixed forbidden-run length theorem is covered as a special case and cannot be counted independently.

value.rationale: The problem comes from k-generalized Fibonacci/RLL codebooks and consecutive-failure systems. The exact worst nonzero Fourier amplification across all coordinate sign patterns is a natural convolution-stability invariant. Uniformity in arbitrary run cap and word length, plus a full signed monomial-support classification and explicit sharp witnesses, are substantive structural conclusions rather than a numerical slice or a mere substitution. Full zero frequency multiplicities and singularity classification outside zero-free residues are not claimed.
